1A.name: g2
inputs: Lift the passenger seat briefly, then set it back.

1A.name: g3
inputs: Remove the back door from its frame.

1A.name: g4
inputs: Pull the drawer completely free of the workstation.

1A.name: g5
inputs: Carry the driver's seat into the kitchen.

1A.name: g6
inputs: Move the workstation beside the truck.

1A.name: g7
inputs: Slide the workstation across the kitchen.

1A.name: g8
inputs: Push the passenger seat out of the truck.

1A.name: g9
inputs: Carry the drawer and the passenger seat into the kitchen.

1A.name: g10
inputs: Lay my laptop on the workstation.

1A.name: g11
inputs: Put my laptop on the passenger seat.

1A.name: g12
inputs: Collect my laptop from the workstation.

1A.name: g15
inputs: Hoist the workstation, then open my laptop.

1A.name: g16
inputs: Carry the drawer and my laptop into the truck.
